perspective:
**Brandon’s available information:**

- He is an insurance agent. He met Benjamin Erickson, an entrepreneur, professionally because Benjamin sought business insurance advice. Brandon was aware Benjamin had limited formal education and initially worried about explaining complex insurance terms clearly, so he simplified his explanations.
- **First meeting:** Brandon heard Benjamin say he wanted comprehensive coverage and that some terms were new. Brandon explained liability insurance as a safety net for business risks, gave a slip-and-fall/store example, and explained asset protection for inventory and equipment. He heard Benjamin say this simplified things and thank him.
- **Second meeting:** Based on their prior interaction, Brandon revised his view of Benjamin’s ability to understand details, felt more confident, and planned to discuss more complex options. He heard Benjamin had been reading up and was ready. Brandon explained business interruption insurance as covering income loss when unable to operate, and property insurance as covering damage and theft. He heard Benjamin call these crucial/reassuring.
- **Casual lunch:** Brandon felt insecure about Benjamin perceiving him as too detail-oriented or cautious. He told Benjamin he worries about getting caught up in details but wants discussions interesting. He heard Benjamin say he appreciates thoroughness and enjoys lighter moments. Brandon told an anecdote about an entrepreneur insuring his taste buds; he heard Benjamin find it fascinating and agree risk assessment matters for their business.
- **After the positive response:** Brandon felt pleased and decided to offer support beyond insurance. He asked whether Benjamin had considered strategic investments to lower premiums. He heard Benjamin hadn’t and thought it sounded smart. Brandon suggested security upgrades protect assets and could reduce insurance costs; he heard Benjamin call it a win-win and agree to explore further.
- **Joint venture:** Encouraged by their rapport and mutual benefits, Brandon felt optimistic and proposed co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. He heard Benjamin agree, ask what he had in mind, call it groundbreaking, say combining expertise could set them apart, and agree to draft initial plans.

Brandon does **not** have access to Benjamin’s private personality type, exact educational history beyond “limited formal education,” unspoken thoughts/motives, or narrator-only framing.
